process_area.title: In-Store Garden Center Care, Merchandising & Sell-Through

value_stream.name: Garden Center, Live Goods & Plant Nursery Operations

fields.Owner: Garden Center Staff / Store Ops (VS-07) / Garden Ops
fields.Participants: Garden Staff, Store Ops (VS-07), Garden Ops, Vendor (VS-03), HSE (VS-24)
fields.Volume: 200 store garden centers × daily care cycles

workflows.name: Garden Center Daily Care, Watering, Pruning & Rotation

Automation Opportunity: - Digital care-checklist by plant need; condition-photo tracking; auto-flag decline for markdown; weather-linked care alerts
Controls: - CTL-666 (ensure controlled execution — In-Store Garden Center Care, Merchandising & Sell-Through (PA-145.2).)
- CTL-666: daily care checklist executed; declining stock flagged for markdown (W4341); care verified
Cross-references: - links to VS-07 (store ops), VS-63 (task), VS-05/VS-64 (inventory/markdown), W4340 (nursery), W4341 (markdown), W4353 (shrink)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Mortality-from-neglect risk**: skipped watering/care → mortality/shrink; mitigated by daily care checklist & accountability
- **Heat/rain-damage risk**: unprotected plants damaged by hot/rainy PH weather; mitigated by micro-climate protection

steps.activity: Garden staff execute the daily care schedule — water by plant need (species/season), inspect/prune, remove dead material, and rotate stock (oldest/declining to front for sell-through)
Garden staff monitor micro-climate (sun/shade/heat), adjust protection (shade net, misting) for hot/rainy conditions, and flag declining stock for markdown (W4341)
Store Ops/Garden Ops verify care execution (checklist), track plant condition, and feed shrink/markdown data (W4353)

fields.Owner: Garden Buyer / Visual Merch (VS-55/VS-62) / Store Ops (VS-07)
fields.Participants: Merchandising (VS-01), Visual Merch (VS-55), Store Ops (VS-07), Garden Ops, Marketing (VS-14)
fields.Trigger: Merchandising reset; seasonal change; space review

workflows.name: Live-Goods Merchandising, Space & Display (incl. Outdoor Yard)

Automation Opportunity: - Light-need zoning planogram; display-audit app; health-in-display tracking; seasonal auto-reset task
Controls: - CTL-666 (ensure controlled execution — In-Store Garden Center Care, Merchandising & Sell-Through (PA-145.2).)
- CTL-666: merchandising plan factored plant light/water needs; display groomed & audited; compliance checked
Cross-references: - links to VS-55 (planogram/space), VS-62 (visual merch/sample), VS-07 (store), VS-01 (merch), W4345 (daily care), W4349 (seasonal)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Wrong-zone risk**: sun plants placed in shade (or vice-versa) → decline; mitigated by light-need zoning
- **Display-neglect risk**: un-groomed display → poor sell-through; mitigated by daily grooming & audit
System Touchpoints: - Planogram/space (VS-55); visual merch/sample (VS-62); store ops (VS-07); merchandising (VS-01)
Time Estimate: - Reset ~hours/event; daily grooming folded into W4345

steps.activity: Garden Buyer/Visual Merch set the garden-center merchandising plan — zoning (sun/shade/pot-size), display fixtures, outdoor-yard layout, and signage, factoring plant light/water needs
Store/Garden Ops execute the plan, place plants in appropriate micro-zones, and maintain display quality (grooming, deadhead, space)
Visual Merch/Garden Ops audit display compliance & plant health in-display, and adjust for sell-through/season

fields.Participants: Garden Staff, Quality (VS-31), HSE (VS-24), Pest-control Vendor, Compliance (FPA VS-22)

Automation Opportunity: - Pest/disease identification aid; treatment-protocol app; outbreak-alert workflow; efficacy tracking
Controls: - CTL-666: daily health monitoring; affected plants isolated; treatment FPA-compliant with PPE (W4356)
Cross-references: - links to VS-31 (quality), VS-24 (HSE), VS-22 (FPA compliance), W4340 (nursery), W4356 (pesticide handling), W4353 (shrink)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Outbreak-spread risk**: undetected pest/disease spreads across stock → mass mortality; mitigated by daily monitoring + isolation
- **Pesticide-safety risk**: unsafe pesticide use → staff/customer/environment exposure + FPA violation; mitigated by FPA-compliant treatment & PPE (W4356)

steps.activity: Garden staff monitor plant health daily (yellowing, wilting, spots, pests), identify pest/disease early, and isolate affected plants
Garden Ops/staff treat per protocol (biological/preferred-first, pesticide per FPA W4356), apply safely with PPE, and document treatment
Quality/HSE verify treatment efficacy & safety, escalate severe outbreak, and feed prevention/protocol improvement

fields.Participants: Garden Staff, CX (VS-13), Store Ops (VS-07), Sales Enablement (VS-124)
fields.Trigger: Customer in garden center; advisory need

workflows.name: Live-Goods Customer Advisory, Plant Selection & Guarantee

Automation Opportunity: - Care-content at staff fingertips (app); plant-selector tool; toxicity/pet-safety prompt; advisory-quality capture
Controls: - CTL-666 (ensure controlled execution — In-Store Garden Center Care, Merchandising & Sell-Through (PA-145.2).)
- CTL-666: advisory care-content-empowered; toxicity/pet-safety disclosed; guarantee explained (W4352)
Cross-references: - links to VS-137/W4343 (content), VS-13 (CX), VS-124 (sales enablement), VS-07 (store), W4352 (guarantee), W4350 (training)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Mis-advice risk**: wrong plant for customer site → plant loss/return; mitigated by care-content-empowered advisory
- **Toxicity-unwarned risk**: customer/pet harmed by toxic plant; mitigated by mandatory toxicity/pet-safety disclosure
System Touchpoints: - Care content/PIM (VS-137/W4343); CX (VS-13); sales enablement (VS-124); store ops (VS-07)

steps.activity: Garden staff advise customers on plant selection (site/climate/needs, suitability, mature size, toxicity/pet-safety) using care content (W4343)
Staff explain the plant guarantee/replacement policy (W4352), care at handover, and attach care card/content
CX/Garden Ops capture advisory quality/feedback, and feed improvement to content (W4343) & training (W4350)

fields.Participants: Merchandising (VS-01), Marketing (VS-14), Store Ops (VS-07), Garden Ops, Supply (VS-02)

workflows.name: Seasonal/Event Selling (Ber-Months, Valentine, Holy Week, Rainy)

Automation Opportunity: - Sell-through-vs-target dashboard; land-date/capacity check; promo task cascade; clearance auto-trigger
Controls: - CTL-666 (ensure controlled execution — In-Store Garden Center Care, Merchandising & Sell-Through (PA-145.2).)
- CTL-666: seasonal program executed to plan; sell-through tracked; post-event cleared (W4341)
Cross-references: - links to VS-01 (merch), VS-14 (marketing), VS-07 (store), W4344 (program), W4341 (markdown), W4346 (display)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Peak-miss risk**: weak sell-through during peak → post-event mortality; mitigated by active selling & clearance
- **Land-date/capacity risk**: peak stock arrives without display/care capacity; mitigated by event staging plan

steps.activity: Store/Garden Ops execute the seasonal program (W4344) — set the seasonal display, stage peak stock at land-date, and activate promo/event
Garden staff drive sell-through during the peak window — prominent placement, advisory, bundling (pot+plant+soil), and active selling to clear before decline
Garden Ops/Marketing execute post-event clearance per the markdown ladder (W4341) to minimize mortality, and report event performance

fields.Participants: HR/L&D (VS-19.4), Sales Enablement (VS-124), Store Ops (VS-07), Garden Ops, Apprenticeship (VS-123)

workflows.name: Garden Center Staffing, Trade Knowledge & Capability

Automation Opportunity: - Competency/certification tracking; care-knowledge micro-learning; coverage/capability dashboard
Controls: - CTL-666 (ensure controlled execution — In-Store Garden Center Care, Merchandising & Sell-Through (PA-145.2).)
- CTL-666: garden roles competency-defined; staff trained/certified; WFM coverage assured
Cross-references: - links to VS-19.4 (L&D), VS-124 (sales enablement), VS-123 (apprenticeship), VS-07/VS-19.3 (WFM), W4348 (advisory), W4345 (care)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Knowledge-gap risk**: generalist staff lack horticultural knowledge → poor care/advisory/mortality; mitigated by certified capability
- **Coverage risk**: garden-center unstaffed for care → neglect; mitigated by WFM coverage plan
System Touchpoints: - HR/L&D (VS-19.4); sales enablement (VS-124); apprenticeship (VS-123); store ops/WFM (VS-07/VS-19.3)

steps.activity: Garden Ops/HR define garden-center roles & competency (horticultural knowledge, care, pest/disease, customer advisory) and the staffing model per garden-center size
L&D/Sales Enablement deliver garden capability training (plant care, pest/disease, advisory, POS), and certify staff (coordinate VS-123/VS-124)
Store Ops/Garden Ops track capability/coverage, address gaps, and feed improvement

fields.Participants: Cashier (VS-08), Garden Staff, Store Ops (VS-07), Customer, Inventory (VS-05)

Automation Opportunity: - Consignment pay-by-scan auto-inventory; catch-weight handling; care-in-transit card auto-print; cycle-count trigger
Controls: - CTL-666 (ensure controlled execution — In-Store Garden Center Care, Merchandising & Sell-Through (PA-145.2).)
- CTL-666: consignment scan-tracked; plants protected for transport; inventory updated (VS-05)
Cross-references: - links to VS-08 (POS), VS-05 (inventory), VS-45/W4342 (consignment), VS-07 (store), W4352 (returns), W4358 (cycle count)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Damage-in-transit risk**: unprotected plant damaged on customer transport → return/complaint; mitigated by wrap/protect & care-in-transit brief
- **Inventory-accuracy risk**: live-goods count drift (mortality vs sale); mitigated by cycle count (W4358)

steps.activity: Cashier scan/sell live goods at POS (incl. consignment pay-by-scan W4342), handle catch-weight/variable items where applicable, and apply guarantees/markdowns
Garden staff wrap/protect plants for transport (sleeve/protect), provide carry/load assistance for large plants, and brief care-in-transit
System update live-goods inventory (VS-05) on sale (incl. consignment sell-through W4342), and trigger replenishment/rotation

fields.Participants: Customer Service (VS-13), Garden Ops, Returns (VS-32), Store Ops (VS-07), Finance (VS-118)

workflows.name: Customer Returns, Plant Guarantee & Replacement Policy

Automation Opportunity: - Guarantee-eligibility check; cause-assessment workflow; guarantee-cost/abuse analytics; auto-route to disposal/vendor-claim
Controls: - CTL-666 (ensure controlled execution — In-Store Garden Center Care, Merchandising & Sell-Through (PA-145.2).)
- CTL-666: guarantee policy applied; cause assessed; abuse monitored; returned plant routed per disposition
Cross-references: - links to VS-32 (returns), VS-13 (service), VS-118 (RA), VS-05 (inventory), W4338 (vendor claim), W4355 (disposal), W4348 (advisory)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Abuse risk**: guarantee exploited (replace customer-neglected plants) → cost; mitigated by cause-assessment & policy limits
- **Cause-attribution risk**: stock-quality vs customer-care unclear → wrong vendor-claim/customer outcome; mitigated by assessment SOP
System Touchpoints: - Returns (VS-32); customer service (VS-13); finance/RA (VS-118); inventory (VS-05); waste/compost (VS-73/W4355)

steps.activity: Garden Buyer/Finance set the plant guarantee policy (guarantee period, replacement-vs-refund, customer-care-burden, exclusions) balancing service vs abuse
Customer Service/Garden Ops process the return/claim — verify eligibility/receipt, assess cause (stock-quality vs customer-care), and replace/refund per policy
Returns/Finance route the returned plant to disposal/compost (W4355) or vendor-claim (W4338), track guarantee cost/abuse, and feed prevention
